summary: Multi-Environment System feature tested successfully - Backend: 10/11 tests PASSED (90.9%, 1 skipped), Frontend: All UI elements verified working. Production and Staging environments shown, System Administrator badge visible, environment badge in site header, sites grouped by environment in API.

issues: Site shows 'No Active License' - expected since staging sites don't have licenses by default. Consider enabling demo mode for staging environments.
